doc: stages/filters.pmf.rst: 'This filter will mark all returns deemed to be ground returns with a classification value of 2 (per the LAS specification).' and 'ignore: Range of values to ignore. [Optional]'. /app/spec/PROFILE.md 1.2: 'Every point the filter *processes* leaves it classified: ground returns are 2 and the rest are 1, where 2.0.1 left the non-ground ones at the input value 0. Points that the `ignore` option excludes are not processed at all - they pass through untouched and keep the classification they arrived with, so running an unclassified input through `filters.pmf` with `ignore` set leaves exactly the ignored points at 0.' terrain.las: 1600 ground-plane points and 52 block points, all Classification 0 on input. stages/filters.pmf.rst also shows extracting a class with filters.range; with no ignore every point is processed, so selecting Classification[0:0] after pmf yields no points while Classification[2:2] yields the 1600 ground points.
